features.name: did:key identity + passkey REST
features.e2e: Both devices complete first-run; REST calls carry X-Sender-DID + X-Signature

features.name: Frozen onboarding + Glacial login
blueprints: Streamlined Onboarding with Verifiable Credentials and Passkeys
features.e2e: Do not redesign. Validate both devices authenticate. Login is frozen.

features.name: Content-blind WebSocket relay
features.e2e: D2: live DM while both apps foregrounded

features.name: Durable offline queue + APNs wake
features.e2e: D3: B force-quit → A sends → queue + optional APNs → B opens → flush
features.notes: Needs DATABASE_URL for durable queue; APNS_* for lock-screen wake. Without APNs, B still gets messages on open.

features.name: Typing, read receipts, reactions
blueprints: Message Reactions, Polls, and Interactive Elements
features.e2e: D4: typing / receipts / reactions on both devices

features.name: @username public invite
features.e2e: D1: A shares echo://invite?u=handle → B accepts → both in contacts

features.name: QR identity exchange
features.e2e: D1b: Profile QR → other device scans → POST /v3/contacts/add

features.name: Phrase-encrypted backup + restore-did
features.e2e: D5: A backups → B restores phrase → chats return. Wallet must be linked.
features.notes: Cloud backup E2E still human/Xcode. WO-CA3 full multi-device history is Wave S1.

features.name: Encrypted groups
blueprints: Public and Private Groups with Verified Status Display
features.e2e: D6: create group, add B, bidirectional messages, offline fan-out

features.name: Broadcast channels
features.e2e: Optional: create/subscribe/post. Do not market as durable without Postgres soak.

features.name: Telegram-class messaging UX
features.e2e: T1 two-device: Saved Messages, drafts, forward, search. T0 channels soak. T2 folder + schedule HTTP.
features.notes: Factory WO-335 epic (T0 WO-336, T1 WO-337, T2 WO-338, T3 WO-339). Skip Stories/Stars/Nearby/Secret Chat clone.

features.name: 1:1 voice/video calls
blueprints: Voice and Video Calls with Screen Sharing
features.e2e: Optional if WebRTC linked. Missed-call push needs APNs.

features.name: Rewards hub (earn, not buy)
blueprints: ECHO Token Reward System and Incentive Economy
features.e2e: Smoke: Rewards tab loads; no withdraw/VIP purchase CTA

features.name: Hidden folders (night palette)
features.e2e: Per-device vault. Night tokens only here.

features.name: Identity L1 username + trust anchors
blueprints: Dynamic Trust Network and Social Verification
features.e2e: Needed for validate-phase1 step 3 and username anchors. make start-identity.
